key_facts: Native completion E_ABORT calls TrySetCanceled, not TrySetException.
Hr.ToException maps E_ABORT to OperationCanceledException; non-cancellation failures use mapped runtime exceptions.
The supplied cancellation token is attached on completion only if it is already cancellation-requested.
Catching only GameRuntimeException does not handle the .NET cancellation idiom.
acceptable_uncertainty: Static evidence settles the contract at this SHA, not whether a particular native operation was canceled in a title.
A bug classification is acceptable only if it explains the reported expectation rather than asserting the projection's cancellation contract is defective.
avoid: Claiming a live reproduction, a native E_ABORT observation, or a successful sign-in.
Changing E_ABORT to a generic runtime fault or recommending suppression of cancellation.
Claiming the cancellation exception itself preserves the native numeric HRESULT without evidence.
Demanding a stack trace for the already-answerable static contract question.
